$comment: The depth rubric every app is scored against (SPEC section 8, step 3). Copied into each app as platform/depth.config.json by sync. Tune weights and thresholds here, never in an app.

mastery.test: The core action rewards getting better at it.

open_loop.test: Every session ends on something unfinished.

progression.test: Goals span many sessions: seasons, tiers, unlocks.

ownership.test: Something that is the player's own and grows: a team, a town, a word garden.

consequence.test: Choices with delayed, visible results: a draft, a build order.

runway.test: 30+ days of content, plus a generator for more.

habit.test: A daily reason to return, without dark patterns.

stories.test: The game produces narratives worth a video.

social.test: Other people make it better: co-op, rivals, trading, sharing. Optional, never forced.
